criteria.question: Does the Chinese say exactly what the English says: the same action, time, threshold, condition, and who does it, with nothing added or dropped?
Are phone numbers, numerals, and the fever comparator and unit intact?
Is it plain, everyday Mandarin written in Simplified Chinese, at about a grade 7 reading level?
Would a Mandarin speaker in the Bay Area find it natural and unambiguous?

verdict_rule: An item passes only when every criterion passes. The receipt passes only when every item passes.
